drums.description: Experimental percussion ensemble piece, The arrangement consists of a deep, resonant kick drum, a high-pitched wooden rimshot or woodblock, and a metallic shaker, The kick drum performs a syncopated pattern emphasizing the downbeat and the upbeat of two, The woodblock executes a repetitive eighth-note pattern with occasional syncopated accents, The shaker maintains a steady sixteenth-note subdivision, The tempo is 110 BPM in 4/4 time, The recording features a dry acoustic environment with minimal artificial reverb, emphasizing the transient attack of the percussion instruments Publish

bass.description: Lo-fi hip hop, A dusty, vinyl-sampled drum break features a muffled kick and a crisp, slightly late snare, A Rhodes electric piano plays a repeating four-bar progression of jazzy seventh chords with a soft tremolo effect, A deep, rounded electric bass follows the root notes of the piano with a slight swing, A high-pitched, filtered synth lead plays a simple, repetitive pentatonic melody with heavy portamento, Occasional vinyl crackle and hiss are layered throughout the mix, 88 BPM, Key of C minor, 4/4 time signature Publish
